content.comment_body: How can I connect an encoder with three output channels directly to [product_name] in order to control the cutting disk's travel distance?

Could you clarify what the three channels refer to? If your encoder has 24VDC outputs, you can connect them directly to the digital inputs of a DC-powered [product_name]. For NPN outputs, you need to use pull-up resistors and note that the signals will be inverted. Within the [product_name] program, step counting can be implemented using counters, and mathematical functions allow you to convert counts to a distance. Also, keep in mind that only some digital inputs on [product_name] support high-speed signals. Please consult the manual for maximum input frequency details.
Hello, Also ensure that the encoder's pulses per revolution and output frequency are compatible with the input frequency limits of [product_name] PLC.

The conversation also highlights the limitation that not all digital inputs support high-speed signals, emphasizing the need to verify hardware specs and manual guidelines such as maximum supported input frequency and encoder pulse characteristics.
